'''October 1998 Portsmouth tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament played on 18 October 1998 at Portsmouth. [[Rod Latham]] finished 6th of 17.<ref name="tourneys">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/tourneys.htm My Tournament Reports], Rod Latham, [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001204191500/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/tourneys.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dst5">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/dst5.htm Mains And Toys], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319183733/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/dst5.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 18 October 1998
* '''Site:''' Portsmouth
* '''Winner:''' Unknown

== Dating ==

The Dark deck is dated 18 October 1998, the date of this event on Latham's results page. The Light deck (lst5) was not preserved.
